title: Phase Transformations in 2D Materials: Some Insights using Electron Microscopy
content: The investigation of phase transformations and conversions in 2D metal chalcogenides is of importance from both a fundamental and application perspective, as distinct electronic, optical, and structural properties emerge as a result of such transformations. The conversion of one phase to other with control over morphology and composition is challenging and requires significant optimization of the synthesis conditions. In the present talk, various means to control and change the morphology and/or phase of 2D metal chalcogenides will be discussed.
